raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tip_amount > fare_amount

raw: SELECT AVG(t.total_amount) FROM trips t WHERE t.payment_type = 2 AND t.pu_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE borough = 'Queens') AND t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE borough = 'Queens')

raw: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pz.location_id) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Manhattan' GROUP BY pz.location_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000

raw: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.do_location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone IN ('JFK Airport', 'LaGuardia', 'Newark')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips t WHERE t.trip_distance > 20
